 Date : 15-07-2024 This petition was called on for hearing today.

Coram : Hon'Ble The Chief Justice
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice J.B. Pardiwala
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Misra

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Somesh Chandra Jha, Aor
 Ms. Pyoli, Adv.
 Mr. Salman S.khan, Adv.
 Mr. Shreay Saini, Adv.
 Mr. Akash Kishore, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Ms. Devyani Bhatt, Adv.
 Ms. Abhipsa Mohanty, Adv.
 Ms. Swati Ghildiyal, Aor

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
1

The petitioner has been denied bail by the Single Judge of the High Court of Gujarat on 28
February 2024 in the case which is registered pursuant to Fir No 11195062220004 dated 6 June
2022 registere
d at Cyber Crime Police Station, Banaskantha, for offences alleged under Sections 406, 420, 120B of the Indian Penal Code 1860 and Sections 66(c) and 66(d) of the Information Technology Act, 2000.
2 Notice was issued by this Court on 19 April 2024.

sentences.text: The petitioner has been in custody since 9 November 2023.
Bearing in mind that the prosecution has cited as many as 540 witnesses, it is unlikely that the trial would be concluded at an early date.
4 In the facts and circumstances, we are of the view that the continued custody of the petitioner is no longer necessary in the interest of justice.

We accordingly direct that the petitioner be released on bail, subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Sessions Court, in connection with FIR No 11195062220004 dated 6 June 2022 registered at Cyber Crime Police Station, Banaskantha.
5 The Special Leave Petition is accordingly disposed of.
6 Pending application, if any, stands disposed of.

(SANJAY KUMAR-I) (SAROJ KUMARI GAUR)
